questions: Do you work or are you a student?
What do you enjoy most about your work or study?
What skills would you like to improve in the future?
speaking.focus: 回答保持 20-30 秒，先直接回答，再补一个具体例子。

speaking.topic: Describe a useful piece of technology
speaking.cue: Describe a piece of technology that is useful in your daily life. You should say what it is, how you use it, why it is useful, and explain how it has changed your routine.
speaking.focus: 准备 60 秒，说 90-120 秒；按 past-present-impact 组织。

questions: How has technology changed the way people learn?
Do you think automation will create more problems or opportunities?
Should governments regulate artificial intelligence more strictly?
speaking.focus: 回答要有立场、原因、让步和结论，不要只说个人经历。

speaking.topic: Describe a city you would like to visit
speaking.cue: Describe a city you would like to visit. You should say where it is, what you know about it, what you would do there, and explain why it interests you.
speaking.focus: 加入地点、活动、个人原因和对比，避免只列景点。

questions: What makes a city comfortable to live in?
How can public transport improve urban life?
Do large cities offer more advantages than small towns?
speaking.focus: 用 infrastructure, affordability, opportunity, environment 组织观点。

writing.title: Line chart: public transport use
writing.prompt: The line chart shows changes in the percentage of commuters using buses, trains and bicycles in a city from 2000 to 2025. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

writing.title: Technology and education
writing.prompt: Some people believe that artificial intelligence will make teachers less important in the future. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

writing.title: Cities and public space
writing.prompt: Some people think cities should invest more money in public spaces such as parks and libraries rather than roads. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

writing.title: Bar chart: household spending
writing.prompt: The bar chart compares household spending on housing, transport, food and entertainment in three countries in 2024. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
